decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component system extends the firm's core spraying platform at low incremental cost, and demand from protective coatings for heavy industry is still developing, so the option is worth holding open.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and documented field use on construction repair sites, so evidence of its value is accumulating and justifies continued commitment.
The transfer pump reuses the proven WIWA air motors, so keeping it on the market costs little while its prospects are still unresolved.
Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's digitalization strategy and is still presented prominently, so it is too early to judge its value and holding it is cheap.
The hydraulic two-component system launched only in 2024, so uncertainty about its value is high and it sits within the core line, which makes holding the option the right choice.
